alt: Unlabelled sagittal section of the lateral nasal wall: the conchae (turbinates) project into the nasal cavity, each overhanging a meatus; the frontal and sphenoid sinuses open above and behind; the yellow strip of olfactory epithelium in the roof sends purple olfactory nerve filaments up through the cribriform plate; the hard palate and an upper incisor form the floor. Servier Medical Art.
